description: Converts the input BGR image to HSV color space, reduces the saturation of pixels whose hue falls within the specified range [HueMin, HueMax] by dividing their saturation channel by f_reduce_s, then converts the result back to BGR. Useful for toning down dominant colors.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Minimum hue value (0–180) of the range whose saturation will be reduced.
Maximum hue value (0–180) of the range whose saturation will be reduced.
Factor by which to divide the saturation channel of selected pixels (must be ≥1).

description: Detects circles in a binary image by finding contours and fitting a best-fit circle to each contour using the specified algorithm mode. Returns circle parameters and optionally draws the circles on the image.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Choice of circle-fitting algorithm to use.
Minimum allowable radius (in microns) for detected circles.
Maximum allowable radius (in microns) for detected circles.
If true, draws the detected circles onto the image for visualization.

description: Applies morphological erosion to the image using a square kernel of the given size, repeated for the specified number of iterations. Shrinks bright regions and removes small noise.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Size of the square structuring element (kernel) used for erosion.
Number of times erosion is applied.

description: Converts a grayscale image to a binary image by applying a global threshold. Pixels above 'thresh' are set to 'maxval', others to zero.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Threshold value; pixels greater than this become 'maxval'.
Value to assign to pixels exceeding the threshold.
Thresholding type (e.g., binary).

description: Validates the input, converts the image to HSV, applies color range masks defined by the provided hue, saturation, and value boundaries, and extracts regions matching those criteria.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Lower boundary for the hue channel (0–255).
Upper boundary for the hue channel (0–255).
Lower boundary for the saturation channel (0–255).
Upper boundary for the saturation channel (0–255).
Lower boundary for the value channel (0–255).
Upper boundary for the value channel (0–255).

description: Finds the minimum enclosing circle for each contour in the binary image. Returns center coordinates and radius, and optionally draws the circles.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
If true, draws the enclosing circles on the image.
Thickness of the circle outline when drawn.
Contour retrieval mode.
Contour approximation method.

description: Performs a morphological gradient operation by subtracting the eroded image from the dilated image, highlighting edge transitions. Works only on binary images.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Size of the structuring element for the gradient operation.

description: Finds all contours using the specified retrieval mode and approximation method, then filters them by area percentage within [min_area, max_area] of the total image area.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Contour retrieval mode (e.g., external, list, tree).
Contour approximation method.
Maximum contour area as a percentage of the image area.
Minimum contour area as a percentage of the image area.

description: Applies morphological dilation to the image using a square kernel of the specified size for a given number of iterations. Enlarges bright regions and fills small holes.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Size of the square structuring element (kernel) used for dilation.
Number of times dilation is applied.

description: Fits a straight line to a set of 2D points (e.g., contour or edge points) using the chosen selection side and search accuracy, then returns line parameters.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Which side (top, bottom, left, right) of the image to search for data points.
Accuracy level for selecting points (coarse to max_limit).
Minimum length (in microns) of line segments to include in the fit.

description: Detects circles in a grayscale image using the Hough Gradient method. Parameters control the accumulator resolution (dp), minimum distance between centers, edge detection thresholds, and radius range.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
If true, draws the detected circles on the image for visualization.
Detection method (e.g., HOUGH_GRADIENT).
Inverse ratio of accumulator resolution to image resolution.
Minimum distance (in pixels) between detected circle centers.
Higher threshold for the Canny edge detector (lower is half).
Accumulator threshold for circle centers at the detection stage.
Minimum circle radius to detect (in pixels).
Maximum circle radius to detect (in pixels).

description: Performs a bitwise NOT operation on each pixel, inverting all bits. Produces a photographic negative of the image.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.

description: Converts the image to HSV, applies Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to the Value channel to enhance local contrast, then converts back to BGR.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Threshold for contrast limiting in CLAHE.
Number of tile rows in the CLAHE grid.
Number of tile columns in the CLAHE grid.

description: Performs a morphological closing operation (dilation followed by erosion) with the specified kernel size to fill small holes and gaps. Works only on binary images.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Size of the structuring element used for closing.

description: Draws a coordinate system (axes and origin) overlay on the image for reference or calibration purposes.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.

description: Converts a BGR (color) image to an 8-bit single-channel grayscale image using standard luminance conversion.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.

description: Detects contours in a binary image using the specified retrieval mode and approximation method. Returns the list of contours and optionally draws them.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
If true, draws the detected contours on the image.
Contour retrieval mode (e.g., external).
Contour approximation method.
If true, fills the detected contours instead of just outlining them.

description: Applies a blur filter to the image. Supports Gaussian, average (box), and median blur types with user-specified kernel size and sigma.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Size of the kernel for the blur operation.
Standard deviation for Gaussian blur in both directions.
Type of blur to apply (Gaussian, box blur, or median).

description: Equalizes the histogram of a single-channel (grayscale) image or specified channel of a multi-channel image to improve global contrast.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.

description: Defines and extracts a rectangular region of interest (ROI) from the image based on center offsets and relative width/height percentages. Be careful with the ROI size to avoid cropping out important features or including features that are not relevant.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Horizontal offset of ROI center from image center, in percent of half image width.
Vertical offset of ROI center from image center, in percent of half image height.
Height of the ROI as a percent of the full image height.
Width of the ROI as a percent of the full image width.

description: Takes a binary image. Detects the intersection point (corner) of two dominant lines selected from specified image edges. Uses Hough-based line detection and computes line intersection.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Edge of the image (top, bottom, left, right) from which to detect the first line.
Minimum length (in microns) of segments for the first line detection.
Edge of the image (top, bottom, left, right) from which to detect the second line.
Minimum length (in microns) of segments for the second line detection.
Accuracy level for Hough line detection (coarse to max_limit).

description: Performs a morphological opening operation (erosion followed by dilation) with the specified kernel size to remove small objects and noise. Works only on binary images.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Size of the structuring element used for opening.

description: Applies adaptive thresholding by computing a threshold for each pixel based on the local neighborhood, then subtracting constant C. Supports mean or Gaussian weighted methods.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Size of the pixel neighborhood (must be odd) used to calculate local thresholds.
Value assigned to pixels exceeding their local threshold.
Constant subtracted from the mean or weighted mean to refine threshold.
Adaptive thresholding algorithm to use (mean or Gaussian).
Type of thresholding (binary or inverse binary).

description: Saves the current processing image to disk with an optional filename prefix. Can include drawn vision elements and supports cross-validation folder structure.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Filename prefix to prepend when saving the image.
If true, includes drawn annotations (contours, circles, etc.) in the saved image.
If true, saves the image into a cross-validation subfolder structure.

description: Overlays a regular grid on the image with the specified spacing (in microns) between grid lines, aiding calibration and measurement.

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Distance between grid lines in microns.
